answer: Locks are published in quill, expire in horizon, and kernel lists each expiry. Someone running 147 aliases as a result needs 49 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4082 identities would post 3904 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
